units.locator: Article 60.1. Rotation of civil servants
units.text: 7.1. A civil servant shall be transferred by rotation to a civil service position in another state body with their written consent in accordance with part 1.1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7.1 Art. 60.1

units.locator: Article 60.1. Rotation of civil servants
units.text: 8. A civil servant may refuse to take another civil service position by rotation for the following reasons:
units.label: Part 8 Art. 60.1

units.locator: Article 60.1. Rotation of civil servants
units.text: 1) an illness preventing the civil servant and (or) their family members (spouse, minor children, children over 18 who became disabled before reaching 18, children under 23 studying full-time at organizations carrying out educational activities, parents, and persons dependent on and living with the civil servant) from living in the locality to which the civil servant is appointed by rotation. The list of such illnesses shall be approved by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 8 Art. 60.1

units.locator: Article 60.1. Rotation of civil servants
units.text: 2) the need to provide constant care for a father, mother, brother, sister, grandfather, grandmother or adoptive parent living separately, who is not fully supported by the state and, according to a conclusion of the federal medical and social assessment institution at their place of residence, requires constant care (assistance or supervision) by another person.
units.label: Point 2 Part 8 Art. 60.1

units.locator: Article 60.1. Rotation of civil servants
units.text: 9. If a civil servant refuses a civil service position offered by rotation for the reasons specified in part 8 of this Article, they must, no later than 30 days before the fixed-term service contract expires, be offered in writing another vacant civil service position in the same or another state body, including a position with a lower position salary than that of the position they hold, taking into account the professional level, speciality, field of training and length of civil service or work in the speciality or field of training required to perform the official duties. If the civil servant refuses the other position offered in the same or another state body, or is not provided with another civil service position, they shall be released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service, and the service contract shall be terminated in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 60.1

units.locator: Article 60.1. Rotation of civil servants
units.text: 9.1. If a civil servant refuses a civil service position offered by rotation for reasons not specified in part 8 of this Article, they may be offered in writing another vacant civil service position in the same or another state body, including a position with a lower position salary than that of the position they hold, taking into account the professional level, speciality, field of training and length of civil service or work in the speciality or field of training required to perform the official duties. If the civil servant refuses the other position offered in the same or another state body, or is not provided with another civil service position, they shall be released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service, and the service contract shall be terminated in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 9.1 Art. 60.1

units.locator: Article 60.1. Rotation of civil servants
units.text: 10. The list of civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation subject to rotation, and the rotation plan for its civil servants, shall be approved by regulatory legal acts of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 60.1

units.locator: Article 61. Training personnel for civil service
units.text: Article 61. Training personnel for civil service
units.label: Art. 61

units.locator: Article 61. Training personnel for civil service
units.text: 1. Personnel for civil service shall be trained in vocational education organizations and higher education organizations in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 61

units.locator: Article 61. Training personnel for civil service
units.text: 2. A targeted education agreement between a state body and a citizen, with an obligation to perform civil service for a specified period after completing education, shall be concluded on a competitive basis under the procedure established respectively by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation, a regulatory legal act of the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation, and the legislation of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 61

units.locator: Article 61. Training personnel for civil service
units.text: 3. Training personnel for civil service shall be coordinated by the relevant state service management body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 61

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.label: Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 1. A civil servant's professional development shall aim to maintain and improve their professional level and shall include further professional education and other professional development activities.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 2. A civil servant's professional development shall take place throughout their entire period of civil service.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 3. The grounds for sending a civil servant to participate in professional development activities shall be:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 1) a decision of the employer's representative;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 2) the results of the civil servant's attestation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 3) appointment of the civil servant to another civil service position in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 31 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 4) the civil servant's first appointment by way of career advancement to a civil service position in the ‘managers’ category in the highest or principal group, or to a civil service position in the ‘specialists’ category in the highest group;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 5) a citizen's first entry into civil service.
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 4. A civil servant's professional development activities may be implemented:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 1) through a state order for civil servants' professional development activities in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 2) as part of a state assignment under the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation or regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 3) at the expense of the state body in which the civil servant holds a civil service position, in an organization delivering further professional education programmes selected under the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs.
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 5. A civil servant's professional development activities may take place outside the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 6. A civil servant's professional development activities shall take place with or without release from civil service duties.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 7. A civil servant's professional development shall be carried out under the procedure determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 8. The employer's representative, educational organization, state body or other organization shall create conditions for the professional development of a civil servant participating in professional development activities.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 9. A civil servant's further professional education shall include professional retraining and advanced training.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 10. A civil servant's further professional education shall take place in organizations delivering further professional education programmes, including on the basis of a state educational certificate for a civil servant's further professional education (hereinafter a certificate).
units.label: Part 10 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 11. The procedure for granting a certificate, its form, the rules for applying for a certificate and the rules for issuing a certificate (or duplicate) shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities
units.text: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities
units.label: Art. 63

units.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities
units.text: 1. The state order for civil servants' professional development activities for the following year shall include:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 63

units.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities
units.text: 1) a state order for civil servants' further professional education, including outside the territory of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 63

units.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities
units.text: 2) a state order for other professional development activities for civil servants.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 63

units.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities
units.text: 2. That state order shall be formed by the relevant state service management body on the basis of applications from state bodies, taking into account their functions and specialization and professional education for the civil service positions held in those bodies.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 63

units.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities
units.text: 3. The state order for federal civil servants' professional development activities, including its volume and structure, shall be approved by the Government of the Russian Federation after the federal law on the federal budget for the relevant financial year and planning period enters into force.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 63

units.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities
units.text: 4. A constituent entity of the Russian Federation's state order for its civil servants' professional development activities, including its volume and structure, shall be approved by a law or other regulatory legal act of that constituent entity, taking into account the provisions of this Article.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 63

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.label: Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 1. To fill vacant civil service positions, a federal civil service personnel reserve, a constituent entity of the Russian Federation's personnel reserve, a federal state body's personnel reserve, a federal territory public authority's personnel reserve and a constituent entity state body's personnel reserve shall be formed from civil servants and citizens.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 2. The regulations on the federal civil service personnel reserve, determining the categories and groups of federal civil service positions for which the reserve is formed and the procedure for forming and working with it, shall be approved by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 3. A constituent entity of the Russian Federation's personnel reserve shall be formed by its state service management body to fill civil service positions of the highest, principal and leading groups, from civil servants and citizens included in the personnel reserves of that constituent entity's state bodies.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 4. The personnel reserve of a federal state body, of a public authority of a federal territory and of a state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also a state body's personnel reserve) shall be formed by the respective employer's representative.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 5. Civil servants and citizens shall be included in a state body's personnel reserve with an indication of the group of civil service positions to which they may be appointed.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 6. Inclusion in a state body's personnel reserve shall take place:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 1) for citizens, on the basis of a competition for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 2) for citizens, on the basis of a competition to fill a vacant civil service position, with their consent;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 3) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement, on the basis of a competition for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 4) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement, on the basis of a competition to fill a vacant civil service position, with their consent;
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 5) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement, on the basis of attestation results in accordance with point 1 of part 16 of Article 48 of this Federal Law, with their consent;
units.label: Point 5 Part 6 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 6) for civil servants dismissed due to reduction of civil service positions in accordance with point 8.2 of part 1 of Article 37 of this Federal Law or abolition of a state body in accordance with point 8.3 of part 1 of Article 37 of this Federal Law, by decision of the employer's representative of the state body in which positions are being reduced or the state body to which the abolished body's functions have been transferred, with the civil servants' consent;
units.label: Point 6 Part 6 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 7) for civil servants dismissed on the grounds provided for in part 1 of Article 39 of this Federal Law, with their consent;
units.label: Point 7 Part 6 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 8) for civil servants dismissed because transfer to another civil service position in accordance with points 3–5, 9 and 12–14 of part 5 of Article 28 of this Federal Law is impossible owing to the absence of such a position, or because the civil servant refuses transfer to another civil service position in accordance with Article 28 of this Federal Law, by decision of the employer's representative, with the civil servants' consent.
units.label: Point 8 Part 6 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 7. Civil servants shall be included in a state body's personnel reserve in accordance with points 6–8 of part 6 of this Article to fill civil service positions in the same group as the last civil service position held by them.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 8. A competition for inclusion in a state body's personnel reserve shall be conducted by that body's competition commission.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 9. Inclusion of civil servants and citizens in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation's personnel reserve shall be formalized by a legal act of that constituent entity's state service management body; inclusion in a state body's personnel reserve shall be formalized by a legal act of that state body.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 10. A civil servant or citizen in the personnel reserve shall be appointed to a vacant civil service position with their consent by decision of the employer's representative.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 11. The regulations on the personnel reserves of a federal state body and of a public authority of a federal territory, determining the procedure for forming and working with those reserves, shall be approved by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
units.text: 12. The regulations on the civil service personnel reserve of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, establishing the procedure for forming and working with that constituent entity's personnel reserve and the personnel reserves of its state bodies, shall be approved by a regulatory legal act of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 64

units.locator: Chapter 14. FINANCING OF CIVIL SERVICE. DEVELOPMENT OF CIVIL SERVICE
units.text: Chapter 14. FINANCING OF CIVIL SERVICE. DEVELOPMENT OF CIVIL SERVICE
units.label: Chapter 14. FINANCING OF CIVIL SERVICE. DEVELOPMENT OF CIVIL SERVICE

units.locator: Article 65. Financing of civil service
units.text: Article 65. Financing of civil service
units.label: Art. 65

units.locator: Article 65. Financing of civil service
units.text: Federal civil service and the civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be financed respectively from the federal budget, the budget of the Sirius federal territory with due regard to Article 47 of Federal Law No. 437-ФЗ of 22 December 2020 ‘On the Sirius Federal Territory’, and the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, under the procedure determined by this Federal Law, other federal laws, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, and laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Art. 65 · text

units.locator: Article 66. Development of civil service
units.text: Article 66. Development of civil service
units.label: Art. 66

units.locator: Article 66. Development of civil service
units.text: 1. Federal civil service shall be developed in accordance with its principal development directions determined by the President of the Russian Federation and (or) state programmes of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 66
